entities.summary: Field Marshal Antonio Marco Agostino Bertoletti, better known as Antoine Marc Augustin Bertoletti, was an Italian army officer who served in the Napoleonic Wars. He initially served in the army of the pro-French Kingdom of Italy until switching sides and joining the Austrian Army.
